about.title: Built by Tesla owners, for Tesla owners.
about.intro: We started EV Works because every Tesla upgrade we'd ever bought, ambient lighting, PPF, tint, you name it, ended up at some shop where the work was sloppy, the appointment ran late, or someone left a scratch on the dashboard. After enough of those, we figured: the install should match the car. So we built a Tesla-specialist mobile install crew that comes to your driveway, knows the cars inside and out, and treats your interior like our own. Now we run EV upgrades across SoCal and you never have to sit in a waiting room again.

apart.title: We come to you
apart.text: Driveway, office parking lot, parking garage — we bring the shop to your Tesla. Mobile install means no rideshare back to work, no waiting room, no whole-day commitment.

apart.title: Tesla-specialist crew
apart.text: We don't work on every car under the sun. Just Teslas. That means our crew knows every panel, every harness, every tolerance — so the install comes out looking like it left the factory that way.

apart.title: Backed by our warranty
apart.text: Every install ships with a 6-month workmanship guarantee. If anything we did fails, we come back and fix it on us. Most shops won't put that in writing — we will.

how.title: Book your upgrade
how.text: Browse EV upgrades by Tesla model — ambient lighting, Yoke steering wheel, or one of our other great products. Pick a model, pick a version, pick a date.

how.title: We drive out to you
how.text: Tell us when and where in SoCal. We confirm same-day. Mobile install means we show up at your address with everything we need.

how.title: Quick and easy install
how.text: Our professionally trained installers will quickly install ambient lighting or other upgrades being careful of your vehicle. We take pride in our work and have never damaged a car.

how.title: Enjoy your upgrade
how.text: Every install comes with a 6-month workmanship warranty and lifetime EV Works support. If anything we did fails, we come back and fix it.
